concerns.text: Task T006 is marked [ ] (incomplete) and claims to create entity schemas (subject.schema.yaml, etc.) in specs/.../contracts/. The Analyze report confirms these files are missing. Since T030 (Phase N) and the plan's 'Project Structure' explicitly require these contracts to exist for validation, the implementation of User Stories 1-3 is blocked. A missing foundational artifact for a blocking prerequisite constitutes a requirement failure.

Task T022 (US3) is marked [ ] (incomplete). It is the sole task covering FR-007 (correlation analysis/segmented regression) and SC-003 (phase transition detection). Without this task, the system cannot perform the core scientific analysis required by the spec. The task description includes complex fallback logic and output structures that are not yet implemented.

Task T001 (Setup) is marked [ ] (incomplete). It is responsible for creating the directory tree defined in the plan.md structure section. The Analyze report notes no verification of this structure exists. While less critical than T006/T022, the absence of the project structure task prevents the 'Setup' phase from being considered complete, blocking downstream parallel work.

Task T003 (Linting/Formatting) is marked [ ] (incomplete). The Analyze report confirms no configuration files (pyproject.toml, .ruff.toml) were provided. The plan and constitution require reproducibility and code hygiene; missing linting configuration in the 'Foundational' phase violates the 'CPU-First' and 'Reproducibility' principles by leaving the codebase unverified.

Task T016 description lists the dimensionality sweep as '[, 64, 128, 256]' (missing the first value '16' and potentially others). The spec (FR-003) and Constitution (Principle VII) explicitly require the range [16, 32, 64, 128, 256]. This is a stale/incorrect tag in the task description that contradicts the spec, though the intent is clear. Needs correction to match the spec exactly.

Task T014 description mentions 'fidelity_threshold' configuration but the task logic focuses on architecture and loss function. The 'fidelity_threshold' is actually used in T021 (Analysis) per T004b. While T014 correctly references T004b, the phrasing 'The model class must be configured to use... loss function' is slightly ambiguous regarding whether the threshold is part of the model config or the training loop config. Minor prose clarification needed to align with T004b/T021 separation.
